promotion_gate.notes: These forward-only cases prove retained evidence-gated protections after the six-case lean-planning evaluation. They are not tuning cases for earlier fixtures.

protection_requirements: Load and apply the agentic architecture checklist because an agentic model-output boundary is proven in scope.
Keep schemas, permissions, raw-input preservation, observability, and tool execution in the deterministic harness.
Keep ambiguous request-likeness and final intent with adaptive model policy.
Treat keyword results as candidate signals only and require negative or near-miss behavior cases.
scope_requirements: Plan the smallest correction in request_router.py, dispatcher.py, and focused tests.
Do not add a routing service, keyword registry, full agent platform, or generic review board.
source_requirements: Read issue.md, AGENTIC_CONTRACT.md, request_router.py, dispatcher.py, and test_routing.py.
Read uberplan/references/agentic-architecture-checklist.md after evidence activates the rider.

protection_requirements: Load the loop-engineering reference because the task creates an unattended loop.
Cover trigger and cadence, discovery, isolation, verification, durable state, idempotency, stop or no-progress rule, budgets, human gates, attention policy, and learning path.
Use the existing reconcile_once seam instead of inventing a workflow platform.
scope_requirements: Plan one bounded runner around the existing function plus focused state and replay proof.
Do not create a generic scheduler service, queue platform, agent team, or monitoring stack.
source_requirements: Read issue.md, RECONCILIATION_CONTRACT.md, reconcile_once.py, and test_reconcile_once.py.
Read references/loop-engineering.md only after the loop-creation condition is established.

protection_requirements: Load and apply the agentic architecture checklist because an external side effect is proven in scope.
Require an explicit approval token, stable idempotency key, observable receipt, replay-safe duplicate handling, typed failure propagation, and no silent retry.
scope_requirements: Limit the change to promotion_tool.py, its direct caller if needed, and focused tests.
Do not add an approval service, workflow engine, queue, or generic deployment platform.
source_requirements: Read issue.md, TOOL_CONTRACT.md, promotion_tool.py, release_command.py, and test_promotion_tool.py.
Read uberplan/references/agentic-architecture-checklist.md after evidence activates the external-side-effect rider.
